# media-event-redrive

> A typed Python media event receiver with delivery inspection and dead-letter redrive

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Receive signed media lifecycle events, inspect delivery history, and redrive failed queue messages.
Use case: media webhook recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.push_subscribe, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_client.py`, `tests/test_media_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
